items.stem: What most clearly distinguishes coaching from mentoring?

options.text: Coaching draws answers out of the person; mentoring shares the mentor's own experience
options.rationale: Correct: coaching is non-directive and client-led; mentoring shares the mentor's expertise.

options.text: Coaching and mentoring are identical in practice
options.rationale: They differ in direction and source of answers.

options.text: Coaching always means giving direct instructions
options.rationale: Instruction is directive, the opposite of coaching.

items.explanation: Correct: coaching is non-directive and client-led; mentoring shares the mentor's expertise.

options.text: Active listening to understand rather than to reply
